{{Quote|Starting to get fond of this junker they've got me flying. I call her the Corvana|Ari Skyff|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''''Corvana''''' was a junker ship used by the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was named by its [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ari Skyff]] in honor of his previous ship, the ''[[Corvani]]''.
